notes: Works on 4K and high-resolution screens, and on stretched pictures. Fixes the aim moving by itself after "How far?" (talk and keyboard noise are ignored; answer with a number and unit). Reads feet and inches on the green. New: "throw club", "can you aim", and "stop" now stops and resets the aim. Better microphone handling with a level meter and a Test microphone button. The problem report can include a screenshot of the GSPro window.
